name: Slow Cooker Chili Crisp Chicken & Rice
subtitle: Shredded chili crisp chicken with cabbage, carrots and edamame, spicy yogurt mayo and smashed cucumbers
time: 3½–4½ hr on high (or 4½–5½ on low), ~25 min hands-on

macros.portion: About 2 cups of the chicken, rice and vegetable mix (~4½ oz cooked chicken), 2 Tbsp spicy mayo and ¾ cup smashed cucumbers.
macros.note: Rough estimate from standard nutrition values for the listed amounts, not a lab number. Chili crisp brands vary a lot in oil content.

before: **30 oz chicken breast** fully thawed. Don't start a slow cooker from frozen chicken.
Load the slow cooker **3–4 hr** before dinner on high, or **4–5 hr** on low. Chicken breast dries out if it runs much longer, including on the warm setting.
notes: An egg-roll-in-a-bowl take on a slow cooker meal-prep recipe: chili crisp chicken with cabbage, carrots and edamame stirred in at the end. The chicken throws a lot of liquid, and so does the cabbage, so most of the cooking liquid comes out before the vegetables go in and goes back only as needed. A tablespoon of chili crisp is held back for the end so some of it stays crunchy.

items: 4½ Tbsp chili crisp, divided (Lao Gan Ma or similar)

steps.title: Load the slow cooker
steps.body: Lay **30 oz chicken** in the slow cooker. In a cup, stir **3½ Tbsp chili crisp + 2½ Tbsp honey + 2½ Tbsp soy sauce + 1 Tbsp + 1 tsp sriracha + 1 Tbsp grated ginger + 1 tsp garlic powder + ½ tsp white pepper** and pour it over. Set the remaining **1 Tbsp chili crisp** aside for the end. Cook on high 3–4 hr or low 4–5 hr, until the thickest piece reads 165°F.

steps.title: Rice on
steps.body: About 35 min before dinner: rinse **1¼ cups rice** until the water runs mostly clear. Small saucepan with **1½ cups bone broth**, bring to a boil, cover, and drop to the lowest heat for **15–18 min**. Then off heat, lid on, **5 min** more.

steps.title: Shred and add the vegetables
steps.body: Shred the chicken in the pot with two forks. Ladle all but about **½ cup** of the liquid into a measuring cup and set it aside. Stir in **14 oz coleslaw mix + 1½ cups carrots + 1½ cups edamame** (straight from frozen). Lid on, high, **15 min**, until the cabbage has wilted.

steps.title: Cucumbers and mayo while it wilts
steps.body: Smash **2 cucumbers** with the flat of a knife and cut into bite-size chunks. Toss with **½ tsp salt** and leave 10 min. Whisk **6 Tbsp Greek yogurt + 2 Tbsp light mayo + 2½ Tbsp sriracha + 1 Tbsp ketchup + ¼ tsp garlic powder** with a pinch of salt; thin with a splash of milk until it drizzles. Slice **4 scallions**. Drain the cucumbers and toss with **1 Tbsp rice vinegar + 1 tsp sugar + 1 tsp soy sauce + 1 tsp sesame oil + 1 clove grated garlic**.

steps.title: Finish
steps.body: Stir **1 Tbsp + 1 tsp seasoned rice vinegar**, the reserved **1 Tbsp chili crisp**, the scallions and **1 Tbsp sesame seeds** into the pot. Fold in the rice. Add back the reserved cooking liquid a few spoonfuls at a time, only until the rice looks glossy and moist, not wet. Taste; add a splash of soy if it's flat.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: About **2 cups** per bowl, drizzled with **2 Tbsp spicy mayo**, with cucumbers on the side.

after: Pack 3 lunches of the chicken and rice. Mayo and cucumbers go in separate small containers; the cucumbers keep 2–3 days.
The chicken and rice freeze well; the cucumbers and mayo don't.

source.label: Adapted from Stealth Health's slow cooker chili crisp chicken & rice
